reviews.text: This place is not what it used to be. The quality of care is abysmal. Our dogs have left the place utterly traumatized.

Dr. Pipes is the best!!!
I requested and received a home visit For my three great Pyrenees from the renowned Veterinarian Dr. Charles Pipes. I’ve known this gentleman for over 30 years and he always does a thorough job and his knowledge is absolutely incredible. He is definitely an Immeasurable asset to Eastlake.
Had to bring my dog, Fred, for an emergency and everyone was so helpful and friendly !! Will be where I take Fred for all his needs!!

The vets here are simply amazing. They are so attentive and patient. I feel like they are the golden standard or care, they give your pets the care they'd want theirs given.

I've brought old beloved family dogs here as well as new youngsters for vet care, overnight clinic care and boarding. They're fantastic and they're open later in the evenings which a huge perk.

My older corgi disliked heights, instead of putting him on the counter their techs and vets would get low on the ground to interact with him. They always follow up on how your pet is doing after visits, and will fine tune medication as needed from your feedback.
Terrible customer service, and the reception area is the worst. Definitely not going back.

Dr. Fling may very well have saved my cat's life. Jesse had suffered for years with a mysterious tumor on his paw which would flare up, become infected, & bleed. It undermined his health and caused him great pain. There seemed to be no clear answer or solution, and in desperation I brought him to Dr. Karen Fling. To make a long story short, Dr. Fling performed surgery, and today the paw is completely healthy. Jesse's overall health is great and he is living his best life. I've met many good area vets; Dr. Fling is at a whole different level. She and her team are phenomenal.

In our hardest days of saying goodbye to a furry, family member, my daughter's Best Friend, Stormi, since she was age of 9 turned 22 (4 yrs. ago now), this place (Vet at time, a true animal lover) didn't give false hope to overcharge impossible cancer end with outrageous surgery, but encouraged time together at home to say goodbye with Stormi Not in a Cage.

Stormi died that night with US at Home Together.

Although, was beyond EXCRUCIATING, we were glad She was with her family, and my daughter got to hold her, tell her, as her best friend, it's okay to go, comfort her, and thank her for being her Best Friend for decades before her last breath was taken. We will see you again, Stormi.

We Miss You EVERY DAY STILL.
NEVER Forgotten, Stormi LeAnn Meadows Spragins, named by Your 9 yr. old chosen little girl/person and Best Friend for Life, my daughter.

Thank you for showing and teaching my daughter how to truly love beyond self Stormi.

Don't go to this vet. They charge 150 for an emergency exam. I brought my cat in for a wound and she came home riddled with fleas. (She's an indoor cat and has never had fleas) Their exam space isn't clean. They charged for a clip and clean, but they never clipped her claws. Never coming back here. They over charge and it was a poor experience.

I took my baby Dallas here when she had a bad allergic reaction to something she ate at the dog park. I was beside myself as she was throwing up and couldn’t breathe. Dr pipes took excellent care of her and she’s back to her rambunctious self. I really respect that he didn’t administer any unnecessary tests and was very informative also checking in her on the next day was very nice

East Lake Veterinary company is a money making machine. They are basically a high end Petsmart with a hospital attached.
They have a line item for everything and is the highest priced Vet around the Lakewood/White Rock neighborhood. The experience is like a boutique with minimal follow ups. I do not recommend this business. If your animal is healthy just take them to Petsmart for regular visits. Cause if and when your pet needs emergency care, that’s when they will gash you with charges. Good luck.

Dear Management at Eastlake Veterinary Services,

I am writing to formally document my profound dissatisfaction with the care provided by Dr. Hille leading up to the passing of our dog, Sookie Faith, on February 2, 2025. After sixteen months of reflection, I must address the incompetence and lack of compassion we experienced during her treatment for lymphoma.

Despite Sookie’s history of "senior moments" and front-leg weakness—which Dr. Hille dismissed—he prescribed NexGard during her chemotherapy. Only after Sookie suffered a fatal seizure did we discover that NexGard is contraindicated for pets with cognitive issues. While Dr. Hille later apologized via phone, admitting he wished he could retract that prescription, the error was catastrophic.

Furthermore, the clinical environment during her final hours was deeply distressing. Prioritizing payment and paperwork while Sookie was actively seizing was inappropriate. Additionally, observing Dr. Hille eating in his office while we were led past with our dying pet demonstrated a disturbing lack of empathy. To be called shortly after returning home to settle a billing discrepancy was the final indignity in a five-year relationship with your clinic.

I am sharing this so that our experience is on the record and to ensure that other families are spared such impersonal and negligent care during their most vulnerable moments.

Absolutely horrible place. They will drain you financially with nonstop tests, treatments, and inflated charges while giving false hope the entire time. We spent over $20,000 here and still ended up having to put our dog down. Looking back, it felt more about billing than genuinely helping our pet. The emotional and financial damage this place caused our family was unreal. Do yourself a favor and get a second opinion before letting them pressure you into thousands of dollars in procedures and care.

I had a really good experience with Dr. Pipes when I took my sweet puppy Maya, in. He didn’t waste time and got straight to what mattered, which I appreciated, and it was obvious he knows what he’s doing. I felt comfortable trusting him with her right away. What really meant a lot was that he followed up afterward and kept checking in until I told him Maya was doing better. That kind of care and attention isn’t something you always get. I’d definitely recommend him if you’re looking for a vet who’s both knowledgeable and genuinely cares.

We came in late on a Sunday because our cat was not acting herself. Dr.Pipe took great care of us and made sure to call multiple times to check up on our girl. She has made a full recovery and we plan on making this our regular vet now.

Dr. Freeman had to move my appointment to the main clinic for my cat so I could be seen sooner. Rich, who works the front, did such a good job and has a great personality. My cat Tank was a little upset with his shots, but is the happiest boy right now because he got to see people other than his brothers or dad, great experience, wouldn't ask for a better staff and doctor. Both the Cat clinic and Main clinic are clean and easy to access, and I don't mind going to either. Great job guys, thanks for making the visit quick and easy!

I don't recommend it. I took my dog ​​there, they charged me a lot, gave him an injection, and assured me he would be fine. My dog ​​died the same day 😔 I wouldn't have cared about the cost if they had just treated him as they promised. My children are devastated by the loss 😔😔
Smells pissy every time. How can I expect to them to take care of my animal when they can't even clean their hospital

Do not use this vet for your beloved pets. I started taking my dog here in 2012 and loved it for the first several years and quality of care plummeted over the past 5 years. Over the years Vets/Techs failed to call me when they said they would while my dog was an urgent patient. I had a vet leave an incredibly vague voicemail right at closing and then was unreachable as she went on out vacation and failed to inform anyone with the information. The last time my dog was hospitalized in July 2025, I had to call several times for updated information hours after they told me they would contact me - I waited for 45 mins for my dog to be discharged and they discharged her and handed her to me with the port still in her leg, I had to inform them and wait another 30 mins for someone to come get her to remove it. They also advertise they provide “24 hour care” which is absolutely not true, they do not have staff onsite for a few days out of the week. I had to ask 3 times for my dogs records to be sent to another vet. Do not trust them with your pets!
Dr.Freeman and staff took great care of our baby Sully. Will recommend to other pet owners and will be returning for any future service our baby needs.

we love dr. freeman! she has been very caring for my big dog and treats him well. the only thing is the past couple of times I have had to call in to the vet is that I’m sitting on hold for 20+ minutes to talk to anyone. other than that, our experience here has been great!

I am deeply disappointed to say that the quality of care and service at this establishment has fallen dramatically. I have been a client here for years, but my recent experiences have made it clear that I can no longer recommend them.

The most significant change is the departure of Juan Maldonado, who was always my reliable point of contact for any issue or emergency. Since he left, the client experience has plummeted.

Scheduling an appointment has become unnecessarily difficult. It is nearly impossible to get in for a timely visit, and dealing with prescription refills has become a complicated, frustrating ordeal that is inconsistent and unreliable. Furthermore, the clinic has apparently discontinued its price matching policy, adding an unexpected and unwelcome increase to the cost of care.

It's clear the standard of operation has gone down, and customer convenience is no longer a priority. I am actively searching for a new veterinary practice now and urge other long-time clients to do the same. I do not recommend this location.

Wasn’t sure on going about it she persuaded  it wasn’t going to be a big deal She said it would be small incision she made it 4x bigger than what we agreed to and decided to shave off his toe nails with out asking

Dr Pipe is the best vet I’ve ever worked with. Called me and texted me multiple times on his personal line in concern about a really odd issue with my cat. Never have had a vet show the care he has, have had vet assistants reach out but never the vet himself, he asked me about how my cat was doing more than my own family. What a great dude

Boarded my 2 Chihuahuas for 5 days. The establishment requires bordatella, leprosporosis, fecal testing and influenza. 5 days there and $1000!  They pile on costs for unnecessary shots and charge a $75 fee for EACH DOG just to give it an un necessary shot. Our boarding costs and "services" were more than our stay at the Hilton!! If you want to be financially raped this is the place!
And the younger dog came back with episodes of diarrhea for 2 days. So much for the so-called mandatory vaccines for boarding. Dog went in healthy and came home with diarrhea. Never again!

Really disappointing. Long hold times when I call, misplaced prescriptions, overpriced prescriptions that they suddenly stopped price matching. Vets and staff were nice, but spending literally hours on the phone to get an appointment or refill a prescription and then having huge bills was just too much.

The worst cat hotel I've ever used. Sending in my cats info, called multiple times to check they had the records. some times they said they had it, other times they told me they had no records. Resent the records 3 times. Then when I drop off, they have you inventory your own food. Then they take notes on each cats feeding plan, but it's a waste of time because the people who actually read these charts don't understand them so it's a waste of breath. I was sent 2 photos that proved they dont listen or read. Then when your cats are so terrified of this place they refuse to eat, you call to ask how they are but no one can read a chart so they end up transferring you, then requesting the doctor call you back which takes hours. When you call back the emergency side which is administering the medicine, they don't even know how it affected the cat 48 hrs later. to have anxiety your whole vacation and pay premium for it then look no further this place will steal your money and give no care about your animal. I hope my cats are still alive when I get back tomorrow.
The best vet we have been to! Very understanding and we’re willing to work with our budget to help our kitty! Would recommend
Dr Pipes was very caring! I took  my lil fur baby as an emergency! He gave great care and checked in daily while she was recovering. I would so recommend this facility.
Dr. Grant is amazing! She is very friendly to me and my animals and is very informative and comforting. I will definitely be seeing her again!

They killed my chameleon!!! I have pictures and messages saying from the doctor when I dropped them off that he was doing better. He was moving around and everything and After shift change when they told me that it was a new doctor now my chameleon is dead. do not go here even when you show up it smells like dead animals. They are going to kill your animals and still charge you a bill.

I took my French bulldog to her regular vet, whom diagnosed her with Bronchitis but her condition worsened. (more so, because she’s stubborn & wouldn’t take her meds) — so, I brought her here for a re-check & they were able to give her a shot of antibiotics & changed her cough meds, and she had relief within less than 24 Hrs. Dr. Bubrig Had the most amazing bedside manner I’ve ever experienced. He didn’t try to upsell us on X-rays, or bloodwork which I went in thinking she needed. He was honest & didn’t rush us at all.   I’m so thankful I found them & they don’t charge extra for the vet visit on weekends! The vet himself called to check on her the next day, and so did the office staff later in the day!   —Updated to add, we had to go back again today, for a self inflicted eye issue, not related to the first visit.  Once again, super quick service. We saw a different vet today, and he extremely helpful & very knowledgeable! To be honest, they are completely fair in pricing- especially for a Sunday unexpected visit!

Took in my sick parvo pup, Dr wasn't thorough, exam fee is affordable but treatment prices are high. After doing research and going to another vet I feel I was given treatment that didn't prioritize the main issues she was experiencing.

I've been coming here for years and have had several experiences where it was clear the only thing they care about is money, but today put me over the edge. I brought an 8 week old extremely sick and starved kitten I found in at 9pm. I asked if I could just have enough formula to get this kitten through the night and I'd get her food take her to the vet in the morning when everything was open. Not only would they not contributed  a tiny bit of formula, but they proceeded to charge me $34 for a can of formula that costs $11 on Amazon. I had no other choice! I'm done with Eastlake.

I cannot sufficiently express my gratitude to the team at East Lake Animal Hospital for what they did to save our dog. Our husky found a very large bottle of maximum strength Advil and chewed up the bottle eating much of the contents. This lead to our dog losing all coordination and falling down in the kitchen. For those of us that didn't know this previously, Advil is particularly dangerous for dogs. My wife ran up there after business hours and had him checked in and the vet was administering emetics to induce vomiting followed by activated charcoal and IV fluids in minutes. We are convinced the fine team at ESVH is the reason our dog is alive and happy today. We are patients for life now. Thank you.
They were great with Luigi and Megan was very kind and helpful!
Frustrated with the “hidden” costs. Totally boarding cost is almost double daily rate. The vet didn’t do all the necessary puppy vaccinations at the same time so we had to pay 2x for doctor visits.

I really wanted to like this vet. The facility is very nice, comfy boarding options, and the staff are always lovely when we go in. My issue is not due to any single staff member. However the operation as a whole is very disorganized which makes me question the quality of care and leadership. Renewing my cat's prescription always requires a long back and forth of calls despite this being the same prescription they have written before! They claim the issue is that I use an external pharmacy, but that should have nothing to do with it. It's the same prescription to the same pharmacy that they have sent it to every other time. You would think there would be some urgency in authorizing seizure medication! Long story short, we are moving all four of our pets to another vet.
Love the team!!

Way too expensive. If you have a dog you at least see a doctor for a checkup. For a cat they just take the cat away and bring them back and say she’s fine had her shots. You really don’t know if anyone even saw her. They are really ridiculous.

The worst of the worst. They should be ashamed of themselves but they have no heart and their soul will end up down below.... HORRIBLE...TERRIBLE....If you believe you are important or your pets health is important....you must be stupid. They focus on selling you anything and everything and it won't do anything to your pet.... Finance first... Pets place second.
I'm there speaking about his growth on his anus....they are pushing movoflex on me....I absolutely despise these people and place.

I have been bringing my pets there for almost 20 years. Always received excellent care and follow up. However,  the quality of "care" has gone downhill and I have been disappointed.  I had to put down one of my pets while out of town over Thanksgiving, when I  called to notify them of the situation, they person just said she would make a notation. NO SYMPATHY WHATSOEVER. In the past,  had received a sympathy card signed by the staff. This time,nothing. I just recently had a pet stay in the hospital for 2 days. After coming home, there was no follow-up call the next day to see how she was doing. I had to call and report health not improving and after picking up 3 additional prescriptions, no follow up call the next day. It seems all of the "care" has left the building.

I cannot say enough positive things about Eastlake and their staff! Last week, my 4 year old dog wound up paralyzed from the heind legs down. I went to 3 different vets before I wound up at Eastlake and the only treatment option I had been given was a $20k surgery that I simply couldn’t afford.

Eastlake was the first hospital that even bothered to take x-rays and then to offer a non-surgical treatment plan that utilmately worked! We have a long road to full recovery but, I ended up at 1/10th of the cost of a surgery with the same ideal end result.

I realize too that not everybody’s experience will be the same however, I will say that I will be a customer for life and I have never been comfortable leaving any of my animals in the care of anyone I didn’t know but now I will sleep easy, knowing that my animals have a incredible source of knowledge and expertise in the event they ever need it.

Absolutely recommend, 1000%!
We love ELPO and their kind, dedicated, and knowledgeable volunteers and staff.  We adopted our sweet Aussie mix who lights up our life.

Worst experience with any vet I’ve ever had.
Took 2 Foster puppies in for initial care visit they tested and claimed they had Parvo and needed either immediate hospitalization or outpatient care to have a chance. Politely declined as the cost was exorbitant and wanted a second opinion. Took the puppies to another vet not much further away, for the initial care visit, prescriptions and shots it cost  OVER HALF as much as what East Lake was charging for the two combined and provided in my opinion, much higher quality care. I had simply moved on and would never come here again, however they end up sending me a notice almost 2 months later saying due to a “clerical error” on their end they needed MORE money… thankfully the puppies are thriving and perfectly healthy now. But if you are considering taking your pets here STAY AWAY. There are much better places nearby for routine and emergency care that are not anywhere near as overpriced and provide much higher quality of care.
This place is not worth your time or money and is full of nothing but incompetence.

I took my tortoise in two days before Thanksgiving, He had a respiratory infection and simply needed antibiotics. I knew this veterinarian was not a board-certified reptile vet but I naïvely thought any vet could handle proper antibiotics and dosing. I would’ve gone to my regular vet in Grapevine, but with the timing of Thanksgiving and the holidays, this seemed to be the better option and I completely regret my decision. There were so many red flags when I was there and incorrect statements made during the visit. I should have left, the whole visit gave me anxiety, but I felt desperate with the holiday coming and wanted my animal to get better. They didn’t even carry the proper antibiotics. They had to rush order it and charged me extra, There were so many signs that this was not the right place when they don’t even have the proper medication on hand. I even had to wait over two hours for my medication the next day because they didn’t know the proper dosage and ‘had to check’.

After going through the full course of antibiotics, my poor guy was not getting better, there was some tiny improvement where he started nibbling at food but then once he finished the antibiotic he quickly started going downhill. Once I took him to my regular vet, they confirmed that I was given the improper antibiotic dosage. It was much too low for the size of my tortoise. Extremely valuable time had been wasted because of this and their mistake cost my tortoise his life!

I am so angry at this Vet for playing ‘reptile vet’ when they clearly don’t know what they’re doing and don’t have the proper training. It is entirely unethical for them to even see reptiles without the proper knowledge and it speaks to an incredible amount of ego and undeserved confidence for them to think they can just ‘wing it’ and ‘figure it out’. Do not bring reptiles here!
So caring for your pet and they price match online for prescriptions and best of all, open on Sundays!  Oh ya, fair pricing compared to all those fear mongering corporate vets

I recently adopted my kitty, Elvis, from the orphanage . He’s a great companion to me and the more mature cat, Pedro. I take them both there for checkups, and to the hotel. When you take your felines there check out the cards and gifts! The staff and vets are state of the art professionals! My cats appreciate all that you do for them.
Dr and staff are the most supoortive and they will work with you. Dr Freeman was the kindliest Vet I have ever known.

I am a pre-vet student that reached out to interview a Veterinarian in this clinic for a project that I am doing for one of my lectures. They answered the phone quickly and they're so nice to let me know who I can interview. They answered all of my questions and even gave me a brief lesson on who they are and what types of animals they see daily. Also, any other Pre-Vet student that want to volunteer to get experience this place also has volunteer opportunities! Overall, they are amazing and great.
Cathy at the front desk has one of the sweetest auras of a veterinary worker I have ever met! I work with a pet aquamation facility and I appreciate genuine people like her.
The markup on their pet insulin in ridiculous.  Very disappointed.

IF YOU CARE ABOUT YOUR ANIMAL, FIND A DIFFERENT VET.

So, I brought in a new 5 month old mixed German Shepherd puppy I got from the SPCA for an initial checkup and review of her health. She's a beautiful puppy with a great personality, but unfortunately, she had an intestinal infection. No big deal, right?

We'll, it turns out that it is a big deal when the veterinary clinic fails to notify the pet owner! A POSITIVE TEST RESULT with no notification of any kind. No call, no text, no email was received.
Do you know how I found out?

30 days later, my puppy and I returned for a booster for one of her vaccines. The vet tech sees her and doesn't say a word about any parasite infection. Obviously didn't review her records, because she doesn't inform us of any infection. We're still in the dark.

Then the veterinarian herself sees us, you know, the person with the advanced degree and the responsibility and guess what? Obviously, the veterinarian didn't review my puppy's records either, because she doesn't tell us the dog is infected either. This is an example of egregious care or better, the lack thereof.

I finally found out that my pet had a problem when the billing person at the front desk asked why there was an open invoice for medicine to treat an intestinal parasite on our account. It was the medicine for her parasites that we never received or even knew we needed!

Billing told me my dog was sick. Not the vet tech, not the veterinarian, the billing person! And this notification was 27 DAYS AFTER THE DOG WAS TESTED POSITIVE. Not good at all.

Brought her home and we did the medicine. Still no call. Still no veterinarian that cared enough for my pet to even inquire.

So I call them. No one seems to want to talk about it. I still have not talked to any of the vets about this. Business manager promised me a refund. Still waiting on that, like I waited on hearing from them after the positive test result.

IF YOU CARE ABOUT YOUR ANIMAL, FIND A DIFFERENT VET. The care your pet will receive here is not good.

Four months later... Crickets only.

We hadn’t had the best experiences already but they were close and our dog has anxiety in the car so it seemed like the best option for a time. Once we had actual emergencies they used scare tactics to try to get us to agree to treatment. …

I just want to say how happy I am with the care of Tanner my sweet baby girl. She is 17 years old. At Eastlake Veterinary Hospital. That has been boarded there numerous times. The staff and nurses. Have gone above and beyond their call of …

Dr. Freeman was awesome  with our little wren. Because of ELVC. We are moving from our old vet to you all and bringing our other puppies willow and wolfie. Thank you all so much especially Dr. Freeman.

I don’t recommend. I’ve taken my dog here twice for boarding and some shots. First time was fine, second was sketchy. They said he needed a poop sample before behind boarded and doing day care, and I agreed. I got a call about 4 hours after …

We had an appointment and had been waiting quite a while, when nurse Amber realized this, we were attended to right away. It’s so unnerving when ur pets are sick so I really appreciate East Lake Vet Hosp for being so accommodating and helpful whenever our dogs are in need.  Thank you !
